landing.heroTitle: [te] Where Farmers, Technology and Opportunity Connect.
landing.heroSubtitle: [te] Uzhavan Connect unifies smallholder farmers directly with institutional food processors and retailers using ML demand forecasting, algorithmic matching, fair price discovery, and cold-chain route coordination.
landing.autonomousEscrowDesc: [te] Zero credit risk, transparent direct payout
landing.cycleFlow: [te] Farmer Produce → AI Demand Aggregation → Smart Matching → FPO Hub → QC & Cold Transport → Dockside Settlement
landing.problemTitle: [te] Core Challenges in Traditional Agricultural Supply Chains
landing.problemSubtitle: [te] Multiple intermediaries reduce farmer earnings and inflate consumer prices.
landing.whySubtitle: [te] A demand-driven, algorithmic operating framework built for transparency and efficiency.
landing.joinTitle: [te] Choose Your Operating Role to Join
landing.joinSubtitle: [te] Direct registration designed for farmers, cooperatives, and commercial buyers.
landing.joinFarmerDesc: [te] List harvest, discover fair mandi benchmark rates, and receive instant direct escrow bank deposits.
landing.joinBuyerDesc: [te] Aggregate forward demand, secure farm-fresh produce with batch lab tests, and track cold deliveries.
landing.joinFpoDesc: [te] Coordinate village harvesting, run grading stations, package with QR passports, and disburse member payouts.
landing.joinBulkDesc: [te] Procure industrial volumes from verified FPO clusters, monitor live reefer telematics, and automate invoices.
landing.fragmentedDemandDesc: [te] Small retailers purchase independently, inflating ordering costs and driving speculative local arbitrage.
landing.fragmentedSupplyDesc: [te] 86% of Indian farmers are smallholders lacking individual bargaining power or volume scale.
landing.uncertainPricingDesc: [te] Farmers bring produce blindly to mandis, where distress sales depress gate prices to 30-40% of retail.
landing.duplicateLogisticsDesc: [te] Uncoordinated mini-trucks make redundant single-drop runs with 40%+ empty return miles and no cold chain.
landing.slowMatchingDesc: [te] Spot telephone negotiations and 4-6 intermediary touchpoints create 48 to 72 hour delays for perishable goods.
landing.limitedDemandVisibilityDesc: [te] Farmers plant without knowing market demand 3 months later, triggering recurrent glut-and-famine cycles.
landing.postHarvestLossDesc: [te] Over 20% of Indian horticultural produce rots in transit due to lack of pre-cooling and refrigerated routing.
landing.opaqueRealizationDesc: [te] No itemized visibility into transport, mandi cess, or commission deductions, leaving farmers in debt.

impactKpi.title: [te] Impact & Measured Outcomes
impactKpi.subtitle: [te] The platform is judged by measurable outcomes: higher farmer net realization, competitive landed prices, lower unnecessary transport distance, better fulfillment, and reduced post-harvest wastage.
impactKpi.matrixSubheading: [te] Empirical comparison: Traditional Multi-Tier Mandi Flow vs. Uzhavan Connect Digitally Coordinated Network
impactKpi.netRealizationDesc: [te] By eliminating speculative trader margins and commission agent cuts, farmers receive ₹27.50/kg vs ₹16.00/kg under traditional mandis, with zero payment delays.
impactKpi.affordabilityDesc: [te] Bulk institutional buyers and consumers pay ₹32.00/kg landed instead of ₹38.00/kg retail mandi prices, lowering food inflation while securing verified Grade A quality.
impactKpi.coldChainDesc: [te] Dynamic micro-hub pre-cooling and Google OR-Tools route optimization reduce post-harvest horticultural wastage from 22.4% down to just 3.8%.

middlemanSimulator.title: [te] Where Does Your ₹100 Go?
middlemanSimulator.subtitle: [te] Comparing a fragmented 6-tier intermediary chain against Uzhavan Connect’s digitally coordinated demand-first network.
middlemanSimulator.traditionalDesc: [te] Multiple speculative commissions, unauthorized cuts, and uncoordinated multi-leg transport erode farmer earnings.
middlemanSimulator.uzhavanDesc: [te] Retains essential aggregation and cold logistics, but replaces speculative middlemen with transparent digital coordination.
middlemanSimulator.crucialPrincipleDesc: [te] We do not naively claim that every intermediary function disappears. Aggregation, grading, cold pre-cooling, and transportation are essential physical services. Uzhavan Connect digitally targets and replaces unnecessary coordination and speculative information layers, ensuring farmers retain genuine net realization while logistics and aggregation remain efficient and transparent.
